depth.slippage_convention: Per-chain marginal execution-rate deterioration from each chain's $100 baseline rung; signed cost. No cross-chain scalar is computed.
depth.basis: Fresh chain-local routed ladders were measured independently on Ethereum, Arbitrum, Base, and Avalanche. A single asset-level depth is deliberately withheld because balances cannot be assumed movable between chains at zero cost, delay, or bridge risk. PegTracker's cross-chain [10M, 20M] aggregate is not used.

market_price_cross_check.note: ⚠️ THE TWO MARKS DISAGREE BY 269bps AND BOTH ARE LIVE. The published mark is the SMALLER Monad pool ($106,572 reserve, $0.00 traded in 24h); routing reaches the 3.5x larger csUSDC pool. Against NAV that is -0.009% versus -2.695% — so the headline discount depends on which venue you call the market. Two pools 3.5x apart quoting one asset differently, unarbitraged, IS the liquidity finding; it is published rather than resolved by picking a side.

The hand-derived monad_refined_bracket below is retained as the first measurement of record; it read [$201,953 - $203,711] at ~08:50Z, the daily job read [$228,320 - $230,078] at ~10:00Z. monad_proceeds_ceiling_csusdc.reading: Proceeds plateau at ~205K csUSDC: the Monad Balancer pools' counter-side is exhausted by ~$210K of syzUSD. Beyond that the router adds limit-order dust.

cross_checks.monad_total_convention_note: Under the TOTAL convention against PegTracker's 1.084155 mark, Monad reads -248.64bps at $100 and crosses 2% at the FIRST rung: syzUSD trades ~2.5% below that mark on Monad at every size. That is a cross-chain basis (the mark is the Plasma NAV-per-share 1.0834; the Plasma venue is a $14.8K pool), not impact, and the marginal bracket above measures impact only.
cross_checks.plasma_reading: 55.6M of the 76.3M syzUSD supply (72.9%) is on Plasma and the router finds NO ROUTE to USDT0 at any size ($1K-$10M). The only DEX presence is two Pendle PT/SY pools ($71K, not a spot exit) and a $14.8K Balancer v3 syzUSD/USDT0 pool the router does not reach. This is a finding about the asset: the dominant deployment has no executable secondary exit.
cross_checks.ethereum_reading: 276K syzUSD on Ethereum. $1K returns 15.71 USDC through a dust Uniswap v4 pool (invalid_quote); above $10K the router refuses (amount_exceeds_router_max). No executable exit.
